author: 尼采
text: 人身上伟大的，是他是一座桥而不是一个目的；人身上可爱的，是他是一次过渡和一次没落。
concept: 绳索与桥（man is a rope, a bridge）
locus: 《查拉图斯特拉如是说》序言·第 4 节
quote: What is great in man is that he is a bridge and not a goal: what is lovable in man is that he is an OVER-GOING and a DOWN-GOING.
source: Thomas Common 英译（公版，Project Gutenberg #1998）

author: 尼采
text: 我告诉你们：人必须身怀混沌，才能生出一颗跳舞的星。我告诉你们：你们身上还有混沌。
concept: 混沌与跳舞的星（chaos and the dancing star）
locus: 《查拉图斯特拉如是说》序言·第 5 节
quote: I tell you: one must still have chaos in one, to give birth to a dancing star. I tell you: ye have still chaos in you.
source: Thomas Common 英译（公版，Project Gutenberg #1998）

author: 尼采
text: 我们杀戮，靠的不是愤怒，而是笑。来，让我们杀死那沉重的精神！
concept: 以笑杀之（not by wrath, but by laughter）
locus: 《查拉图斯特拉如是说》第一部·论读与写
quote: Not by wrath, but by laughter, do we slay. Come, let us slay the spirit of gravity!
source: Thomas Common 英译（公版，Project Gutenberg #1998）

author: 尼采
text: 逃吧，我的朋友，逃进你的孤独里去！我看见你被大人物的喧嚣震聋，被小人物的芒刺蜇得遍体鳞伤。
concept: 市场之蝇（the flies in the market-place）
locus: 《查拉图斯特拉如是说》第一部·论市场之蝇
quote: Flee, my friend, into thy solitude! I see thee deafened with the noise of the great men, and stung all over with the stings of the little ones.
source: Thomas Common 英译（公版，Project Gutenberg #1998）

author: 尼采
text: 看哪！我厌倦了我的智慧，像采了太多蜜的蜂；我需要伸来接取的手。
concept: 采了太多蜜的蜂（the bee with too much honey）
locus: 《查拉图斯特拉如是说》序言·第 1 节
quote: Lo! I am weary of my wisdom, like the bee that hath gathered too much honey; I need hands outstretched to take it.
source: Thomas Common 英译（公版，Project Gutenberg #1998）
